thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: hosted-api-uswest queue length rising sharply. p95 ~ 6s, p99 ~ 24s, GPU pool 'uswest-encoder' at 100% utilization. Auto-scaler failing to provision new nodes (rate limit errors).

sre-oncall: I'm on it, paging infra. grabbing logs.

cheng: saw a cluster of large batched requests from tenant `ad-analytics` starting ~ 17:03. queue growth correlates.

maria: customer-success FYI — CS dashboard shows increased error rate for a handful of customers, likely impacted.

infra-team: getting the autoscaler logs now, seeing `quota_exceeded: create_instances` errors from cloud provider.

mohit: can we temporarily reject very large requests? we have an "oom_guard" feature we can flip to fail > 16k token requests.

sre-oncall: yes, enable oom_guard for hosted-api-uswest and reduce batch size. Do we have the toggle?

cheng: toggle is `redwood.ops.features.oom_guard` in console. endpoints -> uswest -> runtime flags. I'll flip and set `max_request_tokens=16000` and `batch_max_tokens=4096`.

maria: doing communication to affected accounts: heads up message drafted, waiting on confirmation of mitigation.

infra-team: opened ticket with cloud provider for quota bump (TICKET-9482). They say ~30-45m ETA for quota increase.

sre-oncall: mitigation plan: 1) enable oom_guard (cheng) 2) enable circuit-breaker throttle at 80rps for low-tier (mohit) 3) temporarily disable large-request batching (cheng) 4) reroute high-volume tenant to dedicated pool if available (infra-team).

cheng: oom_guard enabled at 17:09 UTC. batch size reduced. watch metrics.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Action logged: feature_toggle by cheng at 1769876943.

mohit: enabling per-tenant throttle rule now: `rule: tenant.ad-analytics rate_limit=60rps delay=0`

infra-team: we have a spare dedicated node in eu that could be used as temporary relief but cross-region latency tradeoffs. asking for approval.

maria: CS approves temporary reroute for ad-analytics to dedicated eu-pool if it reduces failures. notify customers.

sre-oncall: reroute initiated for tenant ad-analytics -> dedicated-eu-pool. will monitor for errors.

incident-bot: metrics update: queue_length dropped from 12k -> 2.3k in 6m after toggles. p99 down to 9.6s. GPU utilization 100% -> 78%.

mohit: also disabling long prefix caching for a sec, some requests had massive KV growth.

infra-team: cloud quota increased (provisioned +4 GPUs) at 17:35 UTC. autoscaler now able to create nodes; new nodes coming up.

sre-oncall: new nodes joined pool, we've seen further reduction in queue. p95 ~2.1s, p99 ~4.2s. Continue monitoring.

maria: CS sent proactive note to affected customers, included workaround and ETA. one customer asked for root cause updates — creating follow-up.

cheng: logging actions for postmortem. noted that autoscaler lacked graceful backoff when hitting provider rate limits; runbook step to add synthetic backoff and alternative provisioning path.

sre-oncall: declaring SEV3 -> SEV2 (impacting multiple customers) and open incident channel. assigning postmortem to cheng.

incident-bot: PagerDuty incident acknowledged by sre-oncall at 1769877060.

mohit: recommended longer term: enforce per-tenant batching caps, surface tenant batch size in metrics, and add soft-fail path for huge requests.

infra-team: follow-up tasks: request higher provider quota, implement retry/backoff in autoscaler, expose quota alerts in console.

maria: CS follow-up: coordinate targeted outreach and include timeline for fixes.

sre-oncall: handing off to night oncall at 17:56 UTC — leaving mitigation in place. If p99 > 10s or queue grows > 1k, page SRE primary. I'll write short handoff note.

sre-oncall: handoff note: oom_guard ON, batch_max_tokens=4096, throttle rules applied for ad-analytics, 4 GPUs added, autoscaler ticket TICKET-9482 open, postmortem owner=cheng.

cheng: ack, will take postmortem and draft action items.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident channel will remain open for 24h for monitoring and follow-ups.

sre-oncall: closing active mitigation steps here. keep an eye on related alerts. will update incident tracker with timeline and metrics.

maria: thanks everyone — CS will loop back once postmortem ready.

cheng: quick note for the postmortem: include sample payloads, tenant config, autoscaler error traces, and timing of toggles.

sre-oncall: noted. end of thread.
